name: pg_stats_honor_passed_database
goal:
Resetting counters for a shared relation can update the reset timestamp for the current database instead of the special shared-object database entry.

Record `stats_reset` from pg_stat_database where datid is zero, reset counters for a shared catalog such as pg_shdescription twice, and wait for statistics to flush. The datid-zero timestamp must advance. Per-database relation resets must continue to affect their own database entry, and resetting one database or shared object must not alter unrelated counters.
